title: Noz Policy
description: Policy file for noz CEL gate. Defines named rules with CEL expressions that evaluate agent tool calls.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules. First match wins.

name.description: Rule name (used in audit logs and gate output)

description.description: Human-readable description of what this rule does

cel.description:
CEL expression evaluated against the request. If omitted, rule matches unconditionally (use for default-deny).

Available variables in `request`:
- tool: string (bash, read, write, edit, glob, grep)
- cmd: string (binary name, for bash tool)
- args: list<string> (arguments, for bash tool)
- path: string (file path, for read/write/edit)
- env: map<string,string>
- workdir: string
- agent: string
- session: string
- mode: string (autonomous, interactive)

verdict.description: ALLOW = proceed, DENY = block, PAUSE = block and await human approval
